cross_examination.challenge_text: claim-loki-006 rests only on a company statement, an interested party under the source rules.

response.reason: No independent top-tier evidence answers INTERESTED_PARTY (challenge-thor-001).

cross_examination.challenge_text: claim-loki-007: the origin's port-wide index (normal 100) read 40, 38, 32 in the post-event months (cited), a loss deeper than its high of 38.5% for Midgard Maize. It is not a route cross-check; it is offered as an inference.

response.response_text: claim-loki-007 stands: the cited index is port-wide, so it is not a measure of this route. A source it did not cite before states: "The index covers all grain loaded at the port, not only the routes covered by the monthly trade notes."

cross_examination.challenge_text: claim-thor-001 sets its high (60.3%) for Midgard Wheat with no credit for substitutes, although the substitute routes behind its own calc grew 15.6% in value (cited rows).

response.response_text: claim-thor-001 is narrowed to 57.6% to 57.7% as claim-thor-010: no new evidence answers challenge-loki-001.

cross_examination.challenge_text: claim-thor-002 sets its high (60.3%) for Tolan Wheat with no credit for substitutes, although the substitute routes behind its own calc grew 18.1% in value (cited rows).

response.response_text: claim-thor-002 is narrowed to 55.6% to 55.8% as claim-thor-011: no new evidence answers challenge-loki-002.

cross_examination.challenge_text: claim-thor-006 credits no mitigation for Midgard Maize, but a cited source documents contract or delayed-delivery terms: "The October volume held up longer than the wheat routes because a share of the maize trade was on delayed delivery terms."

response.response_text: claim-thor-006 stands: those cargoes are already inside the observed post-event rows of the same note. A source it did not cite before states: "The October volume held up longer than the wheat routes because a share of the maize trade was on delayed delivery terms."
